                if nxt in allowed_set and nxt not in dist:
                    dist[nxt] = cur_d + 1
                    queue.append(nxt)
    return dist

from collections import deque

def policy(me: list[tuple[int, int]], opp: list[tuple[int, int]], color: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    # constants
    N = 11
    board = set((i,j) for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
    empties = board - set(me) - set(opp)
    if not empties:
        # Should not happen, but return some fallback
        return (0,0)
    
    neighbor_offsets = [(-1,0), (0,-1), (0,1), (1,0), (1,-1), (-1,1)]
    
    # BFS helper
    def bfs(src_cells, allowed_set):
        dist = {}
        q = deque()
        for src in src_cells:
            if src in allowed_set:
                dist[src] = 0
                q.append(src)
        while q:
            r,c = q.popleft()
            cur = dist[(r,c)]
            for dr,dc in neighbor_offsets:
                nr = r + dr
                nc = c + dc
                if 0 <= nr < N and 0 <= nc < N:
                    nxt = (nr,nc)
                    if nxt in allowed_set and nxt not in dist:
                        dist[nxt] = cur + 1
                        q.append(nxt)
        return dist
    
    allowed_black = board - set(opp)   # cells reachable for me
    allowed_white = board - set(me)   # cells reachable for opponent
    
    top_start = [(0,j) for j in range(N) if (0,j) in allowed_black]
    bottom_start = [(N-1,j) for j in range(N) if (N-1,j) in allowed_black]
    left_start = [(i,0) for i in range(N) if (i,0) in allowed_white]
    right_start = [(i,N-1) for i in range(N) if (i,N-1) in allowed_white]
    
    dist_top = bfs(top_start, allowed_black)
    dist_bottom = bfs(bottom_start, allowed_black)
    dist_left = bfs(left_start, allowed_white)
    dist_right = bfs(right_start, allowed_white)
    
    INF = 10**9
    best_cell = None
    best_sum = INF
    
    # Determine which side's distance is relevant for each player
    if color == 'b':
        # black wants to connect top-bottom
        for cell in empties:
            d_top = dist_top.get(cell, INF)
            d_bottom = dist_bottom.get(cell, INF)
            d_sum = d_top + d_bottom
            if d_sum < best_sum:
                best_sum = d_sum
                best_cell = cell
                # early break if sum is 0? maybe.
        # In case black cannot improve (e.g., all sums INF), fall back to nearest empty cell.
        if best_cell is None:
            best_cell = next(iter(empties))
    else:  # white
        for cell in empties:
            d_left = dist_left.get(cell, INF)
            d_right = dist_right.get(cell, INF)
            d_sum = d_left + d_right
            if d_sum < best_sum:
                best_sum = d_sum
                best_cell = cell
        if best_cell is None:
            best_cell = next(iter(empties))
    return best_cell
